Build the ggplot3 documentation site

Source: R/site.R
build_site.Rd

Renders every gallery example with the package itself and writes a self-contained static site. No external site generator, no CDN assets.

build_site(dir = "docs", quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

dir

Output directory (created if needed).

quiet

Suppress progress messages.

Value

The output directory, invisibly.

Examples

out <- file.path(tempdir(), "ggplot3-site")
build_site(out, quiet = TRUE)
list.files(out)
